description: Source code for the GraphRegistrationContext class in Apache Spark's SQL pipelines module, responsible for registering tables, views, sinks, and flows in a dataflow graph, including duplicate checks and conversion to a DataflowGraph.

classes.name: GraphRegistrationContext
classes.description: A mutable context for registering tables, views, sinks, and flows in a dataflow graph, with methods for registration, validation, and conversion to DataflowGraph.

methods.name: registerTable
methods.description: Registers a table definition in the context.

methods.name: registerView
methods.description: Registers a view definition in the context.

methods.name: registerSink
methods.description: Registers a sink definition in the context.

methods.name: getViews
methods.description: Returns the list of registered views.

methods.name: getSinks
methods.description: Returns the list of registered sinks.

methods.name: registerFlow
methods.description: Registers a flow, combining default SQL configuration.

methods.name: toDataflowGraph
methods.description: Converts the registered components into a DataflowGraph, throwing an exception if empty.
